name: Quantum Touch
description: A collaboration with IBM Quantum & TouchDesigner to create an interactive installation.

text: Quantum Touch was developed for Quantum Jam 2022 as a digital art installation that makes quantum computing visible. The takeaway was simple. Data interpretation can be a creative act, and artists can work meaningfully in highly technical fields.

This piece was inspired by Rothko. Rothko worked with fundamental shapes but was willing to let them be imperfect. This makes for a great starting place for making art with a quantum computer. Quantum computing itself is in its infancy. I set out to create art that uses quantum fundamentals themselves to celebrate the imperfections of the technology.
TouchDesigner handled the interactions and visuals, while the data came directly from a run on IBM's quantum computers.
The code was shared with all the artists participating in the Jam, as an open resource for further experimentation.
